subject: english
question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: The sick woman had raised herself upright, and was stretching her arms tuwards them.
The sick woman had raised herself uprite, and was stretching her arms towards them.
The sick woman had raised herself upright, and was stretching her arms towards them.
The sick woman had raised herself upright, and was streching her arms towards them.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"upright"** means standing or sitting with the back straight; vertical. (सीधा)

 
 
• **Example: **She sat** upright** in her chair, ready to begin the meeting.
 
 
 
• **"Towards"** refers to moving in the direction of something or someone. (की ओर)
 
 
• **Example: **He walked** towards **the park to meet his friends.
 
 

Hence, the sentence** "The sick woman had raised herself upright, and was stretching her arms towards them." **is** free from spelling errors.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1**: The sick woman had raised herself upright, and was stretching her arms **tuwards** them. (की ओर)

 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect spelling of** "towards".**
 
 
 
• **Option 2**: The sick woman had raised herself **uprite**, and was stretching her arms towards them. (सीधा)
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect spelling of **"upright".**
 
 
 
• **Option 4**: The sick woman had raised herself upright, and was **streching** her arms towards them. (खींचना)
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect spelling of **"stretching".**
